body.intro_mizo: Rova leh Mami chu bazar-ah an kal. A pi chuan lei tûr a ziah sak a.
body.intro_english: Rova and Mami go to the market. Grandma has written them a shopping list.
body.culture_note_mizo: Aizawl-a Bara Bazar hi Mizoram bazar lian ber a ni a, thlai, sa leh puan an zuar.
body.culture_note_english: Bara Bazar in Aizawl is Mizoram's biggest market, selling vegetables, meat and cloth.

lines.speaker: Thil zuartu
lines.mizo: Chibai! Eng nge i lei duh?
lines.english: Hello! What would you like to buy?

replies.answer_mizo: Alu ṭha tak tak a awm e.
Ka lâwm e, Rova. Eng nge i lei duh?
Kei hi alu zuartu ka ni a, i lei dawn em?

lines.speaker: Thil zuartu
lines.mizo: Engzat nge i duh?
lines.english: How much would you like?

replies.answer_mizo: Kilo khat, a ṭha e.
Engzat nge i duh tih ka zawt che a nia.
Tûnah i lei dawn em? Engzat nge?

lines.speaker: Thil zuartu
lines.mizo: Hmarcha pawh i duh em? A thak hle.
lines.english: Would you like some chillies too? They're very hot.

replies.answer_mizo: Pathum, ka dah sak e.
Ni lo, hmarcha chu a thak!
Hmm, hmarcha ka sawi a nia.

lines.speaker: Thil zuartu
lines.mizo: A vaiin cheng sawmnga a ni.
lines.english: That's fifty rupees altogether.

replies.answer_mizo: Ka lâwm e!
Pawisa ka phût che a nia, cheng sawmnga.
Ka hre e. Mahse pawisa pêk a ngai.

lines.speaker: Mami
lines.mizo: Ka pi tân thil dang eng nge kan lei ang?
lines.english: What else shall we buy for Grandma?

replies.mizo: Thingpui leh chini kan lei ang.
replies.answer_mizo: Pi chuan a lâwm ngei ang.
Lei tûr ka zawt che a nia.
Pi chuan thingpui a mamawh a nia.

body.intro_mizo: Chapchâr Kût a lo thleng! Lammualah mi tam tak an lâm a, khuangte an vua a.
body.intro_english: Chapchar Kut has arrived! On the dance ground crowds dance and beat drums.
body.culture_note_mizo: Chapchâr Kût hi Mizote kût lian ber a ni a, March thlaah, lo vah zawh hnuah hlim takin an hmang ṭhin. Cheraw (mau lâm) chu a lâr ber a ni.
body.culture_note_english: Chapchar Kut is the biggest Mizo festival, held in March once the forest has been cleared for farming. Cheraw, the bamboo dance, is its best-known dance.

lines.speaker: Mami
lines.mizo: Vawiin Chapchâr Kût a ni! I phur em?
lines.english: Today is Chapchar Kut! Are you excited?

replies.answer_mizo: Kal ho ila!
Kût ni a ni a, mut hun a ni lo!
Ni lo, Kût ni a ni.

lines.speaker: Pi
lines.mizo: He hian inthuam rawh. Kût niah chuan Zo thuam mawi takin kan inthuam ṭhin.
lines.english: Dress up in this. On Kut day we dress in beautiful Zo clothes.

replies.mizo: A mawi hle mai, Pi. Ka lâwm e.
replies.answer_mizo: I mawi e!

replies.mizo: Zo thuam chu ka ei ang.
replies.answer_mizo: Ha ha! Zo thuam chu hâk tûr a ni.

replies.mizo: Ka ha duh lo, a chhia.
replies.english: I don't want it, it's ugly.
replies.answer_mizo: Aw… Pi chuan a lo tah a nia.

lines.speaker: Muana
lines.mizo: Cheraw kan kân dawn a, i thiam em?
lines.english: We're going to dance Cheraw. Can you do it?

replies.mizo: Ka thiam lo, mahse ka zir ve ang.
replies.answer_mizo: Ka zirtîr ang che!

replies.mizo: Ka kân duh lo, ka ṭap ang.
replies.english: I don't want to dance, I'll cry.
replies.answer_mizo: Ṭap suh! A nuam alawm.
Ha ha, Cheraw chu mau lâm a ni.

lines.speaker: Muana
lines.mizo: Khuang a rik hunah, mau inkâra zuan luh tur a nia.
lines.english: When the drum beats, you jump in between the bamboos.

replies.answer_mizo: I thiam e! I zir thuai hle.
Ha ha! Mau inkâra zuan luh tûr a ni.

replies.english: I'm scared, I'll go to sleep.
replies.answer_mizo: Hlau suh, ka ṭanpui ang che.

lines.speaker: Pi
lines.mizo: Rova, Mizoram-ah i lo haw chu ka lâwm takzet e.
lines.english: Rova, I'm so happy you came home to Mizoram.

replies.mizo: Kei pawh ka lâwm e, Pi. Mizo ṭawng ka zir zêl ang.
replies.english: Me too, Grandma. I'll keep learning Mizo.
replies.answer_mizo: Ka tupa, ka chhuang takzet che.

replies.mizo: Japan-ah ka kîr leh nghal ang.
replies.english: I'm going straight back to Japan.
replies.answer_mizo: Aw… hun rei tak awm la!
Ha ha! Kei hi Pi ka ni, nang hi Rova!

body.intro_mizo: Rova chu a damlo. A lu a na a, a khua a sik bawk.
body.intro_english: Rova is sick. His head hurts and he has a fever.

lines.speaker: Pi
lines.mizo: Rova chu i hmel aṭangin i nawmsam loh hmel?
lines.english: Rova, you don't look well. Are you sick?

replies.mizo: Aw Pi, ka lu a na.
replies.answer_mizo: Ka en ang che.
I hmêl en hian i damlo ang hle mai.
I lu leh i taksa ka zawt che a nia.

lines.speaker: Pi
lines.mizo: I khua a sik em ni? I pang a lum hle mai.
lines.english: Do you have a fever? Your cheeks are very hot.

replies.english: Yes, and I feel a bit cold too.
replies.answer_mizo: Daktawr hnênah kal ila.

replies.mizo: Ka khua a sik lo, ka tlân ang.
replies.answer_mizo: Ni lo, i khua a sik alawm. Chawl rawh.
Khawsik hi damlohna a ni.

lines.speaker: Daktawr
lines.mizo: I eng nee nâ a?
lines.english: What's hurting you?

replies.mizo: Ka lu a na a, ka khua a sik.
replies.english: My head hurts and I have a fever.
replies.answer_mizo: Ka en ang che.

replies.english: I used to live in Japan.
replies.answer_mizo: Ka hre e. Mahse i natna ka zawt che a nia.

replies.mizo: Ka natna chu sangha a ni.
replies.answer_mizo: Ha ha, chu chu a ni thei lo.

lines.speaker: Daktawr
lines.mizo: He damdawi hi ni thum chhûng lo ei phawt rawh.
lines.english: Take this medicine for three days first.

replies.mizo: Aw, ka ei ang. Ka lâwm e, daktawr.
replies.english: OK, I'll take it. Thank you, doctor.
replies.answer_mizo: I dam leh thuai ang.
Ni lo, i dam theih nân ei rawh.
Ni thum a nia, kum thum a ni lo!

lines.speaker: Pi
lines.mizo: Chaw lum ei la, tui tam tak in la, chawl hahdam rawh.
lines.english: Eat some warm food, drink lots of water and get plenty of rest.

replies.answer_mizo: Naktukah i dam leh ang.
Dam leh hmasa phawt rawh!

replies.english: I don't need to drink water.
replies.answer_mizo: I dam theih nân tui in a ṭha.

body.intro_mizo: Vawiinah vantlâng hnatlâng a awm. Mi zawng zawngin kawng an tifai.
body.intro_english: Today there's community work. Everyone cleans the road together.
body.culture_note_mizo: Hnatlâng hi khawtlâng tân mi zawng zawngin hlawh lova hna an thawh hona a ni. Tlawmngaihna, lâwmman beisei lova mi dang ṭanpuina rilru nên a inzawm.
body.culture_note_english: Hnatlâng is unpaid work the whole community does together for everyone. It goes with tlawmngaihna: helping others without expecting anything back.

lines.speaker: Pu
lines.mizo: Vawiin hnatlângah khan i tel ve em?
lines.english: Will you join in the community work today?

replies.answer_mizo: A ṭha e, i tlawmngai e.
Khawtlâng tân kan thawk ho a nia!
Ha ha! Hnatlâng hi hna thawh ho a ni.

lines.speaker: Ṭhenawm
lines.mizo: Bawlhhlawh i paih ho ang u hmiang.
lines.english: Let's throw away the rubbish together.

replies.answer_mizo: Ka lâwm e!
Ha ha, paih tûr a ni!
Ka hre e, Rova! Min ṭanpui rawh.

lines.speaker: Mami
lines.mizo: A upat tawh avangin Pi Thangi chuan a in panna kawng chu a ti fai thei tawh lova.
lines.english: Pi Thangi is too old now to clean the path to her house.

replies.answer_mizo: Chu chu tlawmngaihna a ni!

replies.mizo: Amah hna a ni, kei hna a ni lo.
replies.answer_mizo: Mizo nunah kan inṭanpui ṭhin a nia.
A kawng tihfai kan ṭanpui ang em?

lines.speaker: Pi Thangi
lines.mizo: In tlawmngai hle mai, Naute u. Ka lâwm takzet e.
lines.english: You're so kind, little ones. Thank you so much.

replies.english: No need to thank us, Grandma.
replies.answer_mizo: In ṭha e.
Tlawmngaihna chu lâwmman duh lova ṭanpui a ni.
In ṭhenawm ka ni alawm!

lines.speaker: Pu
lines.mizo: Hnâ kan zawh hunah chaw kan ei ho dawn nia.
lines.english: When we finish the work, we'll all eat together.

replies.mizo: A nuam ang! Ka riltam tawh.
replies.english: That'll be fun! I'm hungry already.
replies.answer_mizo: Thawk zo phawt ila.

replies.mizo: Ka ei duh lo, ka haw ang.
replies.english: I don't want to eat, I'm going home.
replies.answer_mizo: Ei ho hi hnatlâng nuam ber a ni!
Ha ha! Chaw chu ei tûr a ni.

body.intro_mizo: Rova chu Japan aṭangin Aizawl-ah a lo haw a. A pi chuan lâwm takin a lo hmuak.
body.intro_english: Rova comes back to Aizawl from Japan. His grandmother welcomes him with joy.

lines.speaker: Pi
lines.mizo: Rova, i lo thleng ta maw! I dam em?
lines.english: Rova, you're here! Are you well?

replies.mizo: Ka dam e, Pi. Ka lâwm e.
replies.answer_mizo: A lâwmawm e! Lo lût rawh.

replies.mizo: Ka in chu a lian e.
replies.answer_mizo: Hmm, i dam em tih ka zawt che a nia.
I lo thleng chauh a nia! I dam em?

lines.speaker: Pi
lines.mizo: Thingpui i duh em?
lines.english: Would you like some tea?

replies.mizo: Aw, ka duh e. Ka lâwm e.
replies.answer_mizo: Ka lo siam sak ang che.
Thingpui chungchâng ka zawt che a nia.

replies.mizo: Ka hming chu Rova a ni.
replies.answer_mizo: I hming chu ka hre tawh e! Thingpui i duh em?

lines.speaker: Pi
lines.mizo: Chaw i ei tawh em? I ril a ṭam em?
lines.english: Have you eaten? Are you hungry?

replies.mizo: Ka ei lo, Pi. Ka ril a ṭam hle mai.
replies.english: I haven't, Grandma. I'm very hungry.
replies.answer_mizo: Chuti a nih chuan chaw ei ang u.
Mut ai chuan chaw ei phawt rawh.
Chaw chungchâng ka zawt che a nia.

lines.speaker: Pi
lines.mizo: Kan in hi i la hrereng em?
lines.english: Do you still remember our house?

replies.mizo: Aw, ka la hrereng e. A danglam lo hle.
replies.english: Yes, I remember. It hasn't changed much.
replies.answer_mizo: Kum tam tak i awm lo a, ka lâwm e.

replies.mizo: Ni lo, ka in a ni lo.
replies.answer_mizo: Kan in a ni ve tho, i pianna in a ni!
Kan in chungchâng ka sawi a nia.

lines.speaker: Pi
lines.mizo: I chau ang, khumah va mu rawh.
lines.english: You must be tired. Go and lie down on the bed.

replies.mizo: Ka lâwm e, Pi. Zan nuam takin.
replies.answer_mizo: Zan nuam takin, ka tupa.

replies.mizo: Ka chau lo, ka tlân ang.
replies.english: I'm not tired, I'll go running.
replies.answer_mizo: Zan a ni tawh, tlân hun a ni lo!
Ha ha! Khum hi mutna a ni, ei tûr a ni lo!

body.intro_mizo: Rova pu chuan lui-ah sangha man turin a hruai.
body.intro_english: Rova's grandfather takes him to the river to catch fish.

lines.speaker: Pu
lines.mizo: Lui chu a fai hle a, tui a vawt hle bawk.
lines.english: The river is very clean, and the water is very cold.

replies.answer_mizo: Kan ram hi a mawi e.
Ni lo, a vawt alawm!
Lui kamah kan awm a nia.

lines.speaker: Pu
lines.mizo: Lên hi min lo dawn sak rawh. Sangha kan man ang.
lines.english: Catch this net for me. We'll catch some fish.

replies.answer_mizo: Fimkhur takin vawng rawh.
Ha ha! Lên hi sangha manna a ni.
Hlau suh, ka awm e.

lines.speaker: Pu
lines.mizo: Fimkhur takin kal rawh, lung hi a nal a nia.
lines.english: Walk carefully, the stones are slippery.

replies.answer_mizo: A ṭha e.
Ni lo, i tlu ang!
Lung chu a khauh alawm!

lines.speaker: Pu
lines.mizo: En teh! Sangha lian tak kan man!
lines.english: Look! We caught a big fish!

replies.answer_mizo: Zanriahah kan ei ang.
Ni lo, sangha chu a hleuh a nia!
Sangha a nia, ui a ni lo!

lines.speaker: Pu
lines.mizo: Ka naupan laiin he lui hi ka hleuh ṭhin.
lines.english: When I was young, I used to swim in this river.

replies.mizo: Pu, chu thawnthu chu min hrilh rawh!
replies.answer_mizo: Inah ka hrilh ang che.
Ka naupan lai ka sawi a nia.
Kan bulah a awm a nia!

body.intro_mizo: Pathianni a ni a. Rova chu a chhûngte nên Biak Inah an inkhawm.
body.intro_english: It's Sunday. Rova goes to church with his family.
body.culture_note_mizo: Mizote tam zâwk chu Kristian an ni a, Pathianniah kohhran-ah an kal a, hna an thawk lo ṭhin.
body.culture_note_english: Most Mizo people are Christian. On Sundays they go to church and rest from work.

lines.speaker: Pi
lines.mizo: Pathianni a ni a, Biak inah kan inkhawm ang.
lines.english: It's Sunday, we're going to church.

replies.answer_mizo: Kawr ṭha ha rawh.
Pathianniah sikul a awm lo ve.
Ni lo, Pathianni a ni.

lines.speaker: Mami
lines.mizo: Biak inah hla kan sa ho ang. I zai ngai em?
lines.english: We'll sing hymns together at church. Do you sing?

replies.mizo: Aw, ka zai ṭhin. Ka zai ve ang.
replies.english: Yes, I do. I'll sing along.
replies.answer_mizo: Ka zirtîr ang che.
Zai ka zawt che a nia!
Ha ha, hla chu sak tûr a ni.

lines.speaker: Pi
lines.mizo: Chaw kan ei hmain ṭawngṭai phawt ila.
lines.english: Before we eat, let's pray first.

replies.answer_mizo: Ka lâwm e.
Nghak deuh phawt rawh.
Ni lo, ṭhu rawh.

lines.speaker: Ṭhenawm
lines.mizo: Rova! I lo haw chu ava lâwm ve.
lines.english: Rova! We're so glad you're home.

replies.mizo: Ka lâwm e! Kei pawh ka hlim e.
replies.answer_mizo: Kan lo hmuak a che.
I lo haw ngei alawm, ka hmu che!
Hmm, ka lâwmna ka sawi a nia.

lines.speaker: Pi
lines.mizo: Pathianni hi chawlhni a ni a. Inah kan awm ang.
lines.english: Sunday is a day of rest. We'll stay at home.

replies.mizo: A nuam e. Pi, thawnthu min hrilh rawh.
replies.english: That's nice. Grandma, tell me a story.
replies.answer_mizo: Ka hrilh ang che.

replies.mizo: Hna nasa tak ka thawk ang.
replies.answer_mizo: Pathianniah chuan kan chawl ṭhin a nia.

replies.mizo: Chawlh ni chu Thawhlehni a ni.
replies.english: The day of rest is Tuesday.
replies.answer_mizo: Ni lo, Pathianni a ni.

body.intro_mizo: Vawiin chu ruah a sûr nasa hle a. Rova chu inah a awm.
body.intro_english: It's pouring with rain today. Rova stays at home.

lines.speaker: Pi
lines.mizo: Ruah a sûr nasa hle mai. Pâwnah chhuak suh.
lines.english: It's raining really hard. Don't go outside.

replies.mizo: Aw Pi, inah ka awm ang.
replies.answer_mizo: A ṭha e.
Ni lo, ruah a sûr a nia!
Mizoram-ah tuipui a awm lo ve!

lines.speaker: Pi
lines.mizo: Vawt i ti em? Kawr lum ha rawh.
lines.english: Are you cold? Put on a warm shirt.

replies.mizo: Aw, ka vawt deuh. Ka ha ang.
replies.english: Yes, I'm a bit cold. I'll put it on.
replies.answer_mizo: Mei ka chhem bawk ang.
Ha ha! Kawr hi hâk tûr a ni.
Ruah a sûr a, a vawt alawm.

lines.speaker: Mami
lines.mizo: Rova, ka lo lût thei em? Ka huh vek.
lines.english: Rova, can I come in? I'm soaking wet.

replies.mizo: Aw, lo lût rawh! Mei bulah ṭhu rawh.
replies.english: Yes, come in! Sit by the fire.
replies.answer_mizo: Ka lâwm e.
Aw… a khawngaihthlâk e.
Kei hi ka huh a nia, nang i ni lo.

lines.speaker: Mami
lines.mizo: Ruah sûr laiin eng nge kan tih ang?
lines.english: What shall we do while it rains?

replies.answer_mizo: Ka duh e!
Ha ha, chu chu a ni lo.
Tûnah eng nge kan tih ang?

lines.speaker: Pi
lines.mizo: En teh, khawdur a reh a, ni a lo chhuak leh ta.
lines.english: Look, the gloom has lifted and the sun is out again.

replies.answer_mizo: Aw, kal ula, mahse fimkhur ula.
Ni lo, a tâwp tawh e!
Chhûn a ni la, ni a êng.

body.intro_mizo: Rova chu Aizawl sikul-ah a kal ṭan. A hreh deuh a, mahse a phur bawk.
body.intro_english: Rova starts at a school in Aizawl. He's a little nervous, but excited too.

lines.speaker: Zirtîrtu
lines.mizo: Chibai! Tunge i hming?
lines.english: Hello! What's your name?

replies.mizo: Ka hming chu Rova a ni.
replies.answer_mizo: Kan sikul-ah kan lo lâwm a che, Rova.
I hming ka zawt che a nia.

replies.mizo: Ka hming chu Sikul a ni.
replies.answer_mizo: Ha ha! Chu chu i hming a ni lo ang.

lines.speaker: Zirtîrtu
lines.mizo: Khawi aṭanga lo kal nge i nih?
lines.english: Where have you come from?

replies.mizo: Japan aṭanga lo kal ka ni.
replies.answer_mizo: Hla tak aṭanga lo kal i ni a!
Khawi aṭanga lo kal nge i nih tih ka zawt a nia.
A ṭha e, mahse khawi aṭanga lo kal nge?

lines.speaker: Muana
lines.mizo: Chibai, ka hming chu Muana. Ka bulah ṭhu rawh.
lines.english: Hi, I'm Muana. Sit next to me.

replies.answer_mizo: Ṭhian ṭha kan ni ang!

replies.mizo: Ka ṭhu duh lo, ka mu ang.
replies.english: I don't want to sit, I'll sleep.
replies.answer_mizo: Sikul-ah mut a phal lo ve!
Ni lo, kei hi Muana. Nang hi Rova!

lines.speaker: Zirtîrtu
lines.mizo: I lehkhabu keu la, phêk hmasa ber chhiar rawh.
lines.english: Open your book and read the first page.

replies.answer_mizo: A ṭha e.
Ha ha! Lehkhabu hi chhiar tûr a ni!
Keu tûr a ni, khâr tûr a ni lo.

lines.speaker: Muana
lines.mizo: Chawlh hunah infiam ho ila?
lines.english: Shall we play together at break time?

replies.mizo: Aw, ka duh e! Bawlung kan khel ang.
replies.english: Yes, I'd love to! Let's play football.
replies.answer_mizo: Kal ho ila!

replies.mizo: Infiam ka duh lo, ka ṭap ang.
replies.english: I don't want to play, I'll cry.
replies.answer_mizo: Ṭap suh! Infiam a nuam alawm.
Infiam ho ka sawm che a nia.

body.intro_mizo: Rova leh a pu chu thingtlâng khuaah an kal a. Chu khua chu a pu pianna khua a ni.
body.intro_english: Rova and his grandfather visit a village in the hills, where his grandfather was born.
body.culture_note_mizo: Mizo chhûngkaw tam tak chuan thingtlâng khua an la nei a, an pi leh pute pianna khua chu an zah ṭhin.
body.culture_note_english: Many Mizo families still have a home village, and they honour the village where their grandparents were born.

lines.speaker: Pu
lines.mizo: He tlâng hi en teh. A sâng hle mai!
lines.english: Look at this hill. It's so high!

replies.answer_mizo: Kan ram hi a mawi e.
Ni lo, a sâng hle alawm!
Ha ha! Tlâng chu lawn tûr a ni.

lines.speaker: Pu
lines.mizo: Ka naupan laiin he khuaah hian ka cheng ṭhin.
lines.english: When I was a boy, I lived in this village.

replies.mizo: Pu, i in kha khawiah nge?
replies.answer_mizo: Kha lam kha a ni.
Ka naupan lai ka sawi a nia.
Ni lo, he khuaah hian a nia.

lines.speaker: Khua mi
lines.mizo: Lo lût rawh u! Ka thlai chin te an nih hi.
lines.english: Come in! These are the vegetables I grow.

replies.mizo: A ṭha hle mai! I thiam e.
replies.english: They're lovely! You're good at it.
replies.answer_mizo: Ka lâwm e. Tlêm ka pe ang che.

replies.mizo: Thlai ka duh lo, a ṭha lo.
replies.english: I don't like vegetables, they're bad.
replies.answer_mizo: Hmm, chu chu a zahawm lo deuh.
Ha ha, thlai chu a thlâwk thei lo.

lines.speaker: Pu
lines.mizo: Ngaithla teh! Sava an hram sa.
lines.english: Listen! The birds are calling.

replies.mizo: Aw, a ri a nuam hle.
replies.answer_mizo: Aizawl-ah i hre ngai lo ang.
Ni lo, sava chu a thlâwk.
Ni lo, sava a ni.

lines.speaker: Pu
lines.mizo: Khawpui leh thingtlâng chu, khawi zâwk nge nuam i tih?
lines.english: The city or the village: which do you like more?

replies.mizo: A pahnih ka duh! Thingtlâng hi a reh a, a nuam.
replies.english: I like both! The village is quiet and peaceful.
replies.answer_mizo: Aw, i dik e.
Khawpui emaw thingtlâng emaw ka zawt che a nia.
Ka hre e! Khawi zâwk nge i duh?

body.intro_mizo: Ka pi ui, Duma chu a bo! Rova leh Mami chuan an zawng.
body.intro_english: Grandma's dog, Duma, is lost! Rova and Mami go looking for him.

lines.speaker: Pi
lines.mizo: Rova! Duma a bo! I hmu em?
lines.english: Rova! Duma is lost! Have you seen him?

replies.mizo: Ka hmu lo, Pi. Ka zawng ang.
replies.english: I haven't, Grandma. I'll look for him.
replies.answer_mizo: Ka lâwm e, ka tupa.
Ui chu a thlâwk thei lo!
Ui kan hmu hmasa phawt ang.

lines.speaker: Mami
lines.mizo: Khawiah nge kan zawn ang?
lines.english: Where shall we look?

replies.english: Let's look on the main road first.
replies.answer_mizo: A ṭha e, kal ila.
Khawiah tih ka zawt che a nia, engtikah a ni lo.
Ui chu lehkhabuah a awm lo ang!

lines.speaker: Ṭhenawm
lines.mizo: Ui dum tê, kawng kamah ka hmu e.
lines.english: I saw a small black dog by the road.

replies.mizo: Ka lâwm e! Khawi lamah nge a kal?
replies.english: Thank you! Which way did he go?
replies.answer_mizo: Lui lam panin a tlân.
Ka hmuh chu a dum a nia.
Ui chungchâng ka sawi a nia.

lines.speaker: Mami
lines.mizo: En teh! Lui kamah Duma a awm!
lines.english: Look! Duma is by the river!

replies.answer_mizo: Duma chu a lo tlân.
Ni lo, a lo kal turin ko rawh!
Duma ko phawt rawh!

lines.speaker: Pi
lines.mizo: Duma i hmu ta chu! Ka lâwm takzet e.
lines.english: You found Duma! I'm so thankful.

replies.mizo: Mami nen kan zawng ho a ni, Pi.
replies.english: Mami and I looked together, Grandma.
replies.answer_mizo: In tlawmngai e!

replies.mizo: Duma chu ka ui a ni.
replies.answer_mizo: Kan ui a ni e, ka lâwm e.
I zawng ngei a nia, i hmu a lâwm!

body.intro_mizo: Khua a lo var a. An ṭhenawm Mami chu Rova hmu turin a lo kal.
body.intro_english: Morning comes. Mami, the girl next door, comes to meet Rova.

lines.speaker: Pi
lines.mizo: Chibai! I mu ṭha em?
lines.english: Hello! Did you sleep well?

replies.answer_mizo: A ṭha e.
I mut dân ka zawt che a nia.
Ni lo, zîng a ni tawh e! En teh, ni a chhuak.

lines.speaker: Pi
lines.mizo: Tukṭhuan atan artui i duh em, nge bawnghnute?
lines.english: For breakfast, would you like an egg or milk?

replies.answer_mizo: Artui ka chhûm sak ang che.
Tukṭhuan chungchâng ka zawt che a nia.
Ha ha! Artui chu a thlâwk thei lo ve!

lines.speaker: Mami
lines.mizo: Chibai, Rova! Kei hi Mami, in ṭhenawm nu ka ni.
lines.english: Hi, Rova! I'm Mami, your neighbour.

replies.mizo: Chibai, Mami! Kan inhmuh hi ka lâwm e.
replies.english: Hi, Mami! I'm glad to meet you.
replies.answer_mizo: Kei pawh ka lâwm e!
Ka inhriattîr che a nia. I hming i hrilh ve em?
Aw… chu chu a zahawm lo deuh.

lines.speaker: Mami
lines.mizo: Mizo ṭawng i thiam em?
lines.english: Can you speak Mizo?

replies.mizo: Tlêm tê ka thiam. Ka zir mêk.
replies.answer_mizo: A ṭha e! Ka ṭanpui ang che.
Ṭawng chungchâng ka zawt che a nia.
Japan-ah i awm a, i hre ngei ang! Mizo ṭawng ka zawt che a nia.

lines.speaker: Mami
lines.mizo: Naktuk zîngah bazar-ah kal ho ila.
lines.english: Let's go to the market together tomorrow morning.

replies.mizo: Aw, kal ho ila. Ka phur e!
replies.english: Yes, let's go. I can't wait!
replies.answer_mizo: Zîng takah ka lo kal ang.
Naktuk tih ka sawi a nia, nimin a ni lo.

replies.mizo: Bazar chu ka ui a ni.
replies.answer_mizo: Ha ha! Bazar hi thil lei leh hralhna hmun a ni.
